title: Myth vs Fact
text: Earth has weathered about 4.5 billion years and roughly 20 trips around the center of the Milky Way, and it's still in one piece. Myth: We only orbit the Sun. Fact: Earth is about 4.5 billion years old, and it also orbits the center of the Milky Way. One trip takes about 230 million years (NASA Science); an older NASA page says 250 million years. Divide Earth's age by that galactic year and you get roughly 20 trips. USGS: Age of the Earth. NASA Science: about 230 million years. NASA: 250 million years.

title: Deep Time
text: Deep Time. One bright line walks 539 million years, and the animals ride their continents the whole way. Five mass extinctions are marked as you pass them. This is who lived, who vanished, and where the land was.
